content: Sɑmuɛli u Sɔɔlu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɛnɑ Gusunɔ wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni u ɡɔrimɑ wunɛn mi, n nun ɡum wisi n kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ u nun ɡɔsɑ ɑ ko sunɔ win tɔmbu Isirelibɑn suunu sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ ye u ɡeruɑ. U nɛɛ, u koo Amɑlɛkibɑ dibu kɔsiɑ ye bɑ kɑ Isirelibɑ swɑɑ burɑ sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ yɑrɑ Eɡibitin di.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ doo ɑ bu wɔri kpɑ ɑ ye bɑ mɔ kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ mɑm mɑm. A ku de bu tiɑrɑ. A bu ɡoowo kpuro tɔn durɔbu kɑ tɔn kurɔbu kɑ bibu sere kɑ bii wɛ̃ɛnɔ, kɑ mɑɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenu.
Mɑ Sɔɔlu u win tɔmbu mɛnnɑ u ɡɑrɑ Telɑimuɔ. Win tɑbu kowobun ɡeerɑ kuɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ ɡoobu (200.000), mɑ Yudɑbɑ bɑ mɑɑ kuɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ wɔkuru (10.000).
Sɑnɑm mɛ Sɔɔlu kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ turɑ Amɑlɛkibɑn wuu bɔkɔwɔ, yerɑ bɑ kukuɑ ɡen wɔwɑ ɡɑɑ sɔɔ.

Mɑ Sɔɔlu u Kenibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu de bu tii wunɑ Amɑlɛkibɑn min di, kpɑ wi, u ku rɑɑ bu mɛnnɑ u ɡo kpuro sɑnnu. Domi be, bɑ Isirelibɑ durom kuɑwɑ sɑɑ ye bɑ wee Eɡibitin di. Mɑ Keni be, bɑ yɑrɑ sɑɑ Amɑlɛkibɑn min di.
Yen biru Sɔɔlu kɑ win tɑbu kowobu bɑ Amɑlɛkibɑ wɔri bɑ bu sunkɑ sɑɑ Hɑfilɑn di sere kɑ Suriɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Eɡibitin sɔ̃ɔ yɑri yeru ɡiɑ.
Mɑ bɑ ben sunɔ mwɑ wi bɑ sokumɔ Aɡɑɡi. Be bɑ tie, mɑ bɑ bu ɡo kɑ tɑkobi.

Adɑmɑ Sɔɔlu kɑ win tɑbu kowobu, bɑ Aɡɑɡi deri, bɑ ǹ nùn ɡo, kɑ sere mɑɑ yɑɑ sɑbe ni nu ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ, yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛbɑ kɑ nɑɑ kpɛmi kɑ yɑ̃ɑ kpɛmminu ni nu ɡum mɔ kɑ bɑɑyere kpuro ye yɑ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ yinɑ bu ye kpuro kpeerɑsiɑ mɑm mɑm. Adɑmɑ ye yɑ ǹ dɑm mɔ kɑ ye yɑ ǹ wɑɑbu wɑ̃, bɑ ye kpuro ɡowɑ mɑm mɑm.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Sɑmuɛli ɡɑri kuɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
nɛn nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ ye nɑ kɑ Sɔɔlu kuɑ sunɔ. Domi u mɑn biru kisi, u ǹ nɛn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɛ. Ye Sɑmuɛli u ɡɑri yi nuɑ, yerɑ u mɔru kuɑ ɡem ɡem, mɑ u Yinni Gusunɔ nɔɔɡiru sue wɔ̃ku ɡiriru.

Sisiru bururu u seewɑ yellu u dɔɔ u kɑ Sɔɔlu yinnɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Sɔɔlu u dɑ wuu ɡe bɑ mɔ̀ Kɑɑmɛli ɡiɑ. Miyɑ u kperu ɡɑru ɡirɑ tɔmbu bu kɑ win nɑsɑrɑ yɑɑyɑ. Min diyɑ u mɑɑ ɡɔsirɑ u dɑ Giliɡɑliɔ.
Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u dɑ win mi. Ye Sɔɔlu u Sɑmuɛli wɑ, yerɑ u nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u nun domɑru kuɑ. Wee nɑ kpuro kuɑ ye u mɑn yiire.
Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑmɔnɑ nɑ kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛbɑn wuri nɔɔmɔ.
Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, tɑbu kowobɑ bɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ kɛtɛ ɡeenu ɡɔsɑ bɑ kɑ wɔmɑ sɑɑ Amɑlɛkibɑn min di kpɑ bu kɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑ ye yɑ ǹ ɡeɑ sɑ̃ɑ kpeerɑsiɑwɑ mɑm mɑm.
Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, ɑ sɑkuo n nun sɔ̃ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɡĩɑ wɔ̃kuru. Sɔɔlu nɛɛ, ɑ ɡeruo.
Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, yellu ɑ tii ɡɑrisiwɑ bwɛ̃ɛbwɛ̃ɛ, mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u nun ɡɔsɑ ɑ kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ.
Mɑ u nun ɡɔrɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ doo ɑ Amɑlɛki durumɡii be tɑbu wɔri ɑ bu ɡo ɑ kpeerɑsiɑ mɑm mɑm.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ ǹ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɛ. Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i kuɑ ye yɑ ǹ nùn dore, i ben yɑ̃nu kɑtɑ kuɑ i ɡurɑ.
Sɔɔlu u nɛɛ, nɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere mɛm nɔɔwɑ fɑ. Nɑ dɑ mi u mɑn ɡɔrɑ, mɑ nɑ Amɑlɛkibɑn sunɔ Aɡɑɡi mwɑ nɑ kɑ nɑ, mɑ nɑ win tɔmbu ɡo mɑm mɑm.
Adɑmɑ nɛn tɑbu kowobɑ bɑ ben yɑ̃ɑnu kɑ ben kɛtɛ ɡeenu mwɑɑmɑ bu kɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni yɑ̃kuru kuɑ Giliɡɑliɔ.
Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, mbɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u kĩru bo. Yɑ̃kunu? Nɡe mɛm nɔɔbu. Wee mɛm nɔɔbu bu yɑ̃kuru kere. Wii kpĩibu bu mɑɑ yɑ̃ku yɑɑ ɡum kere.
Wi u ku rɑ Gusunɔ mɛm nɔɔwɛ u sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɑɑrɛɡii nɡe sɔro. Wi u ku rɑ nùn wiru kpĩiyɛ, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bũu sɑ̃ɔ. Tɛ̃, yèn sɔ̃ ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡere yinɑ, win tii u mɑɑ nun yinɑ, u nun bɑndu yɑrɑ.
Yerɑ Sɔɔlu u Sɑmuɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ durum kuɑ, nɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑ sɑrɑ kɑ mɑɑ wunɛn ɡere. Nɑ nɛn tɔmbun bɛrum kuɑ mɑ nɑ ben ɡere wurɑ.
Adɑmɑ nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, ɑ mɑn nɛn durum suuru kuo, kpɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn wurɑ Giliɡɑliɔ, n kɑ Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃.
Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ nun wurɔ. Domi ɑ Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri yinɑ. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ nun yinɑ, u nun bɑndu yɑrɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Sɑmuɛli u ɡɔsirɔ u kɑ doonɑ, yerɑ Sɔɔlu u win yɑberun swɑɑ ɡɑbɑ, mɑ yɑbe te, tɑ ɡɛ̃ɛrɑ.
Sɑmuɛli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ u nun Isirelibɑn bɑndu wɔrɑri ɡisɔ u tu ɡoo wɛ̃ wi u nun sɑnɔ kere.
Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni yiikoɡii u ku rɑ weesu ko, u ku rɑ mɑɑ win himbɑ ɡɔsie, domi u ǹ sɑ̃ɑ nɡe tɔnu.
Sɔɔlu u kpɑm nɛɛ, nɑ durum kuɑ, ɑdɑmɑ tɛ̃ nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ ɑ mɑn bɛɛrɛ dokeo nɛn tɔmbu Isirelibɑ kɑ ben ɡuro ɡurobu kpuron wuswɑɑɔ. A kɑ mɑn ɡɔsiro Giliɡɑli mi kpɑ n kɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni sɑ̃.
Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u ɡɔsirɑ u kɑ Sɔɔlu dɑ. Sɔɔlu u Yinni Gusunɔ sɑ̃wɑ.
Yerɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ, i kɑ mɑn Aɡɑɡi, Amɑlɛkibɑn sunɔ wi nɑɑwɑ mini. Mɑ Aɡɑɡi wi, u susi kɑ nuku dobu. Domi u bwisikɑ mɑ ɡɔɔ nùn sɑrɑri.
Adɑmɑ Sɑmuɛli u nɛɛ,

content.text: nɡe mɛ wunɛn tɑkobi yɑ tɔn kurɔbu ɡɑbun bibu ɡo,
nɡe mɛyɑ wunɛn mɛro u koo mɑɑ bii biɑ.

content: Mɑ Sɑmuɛli u Aɡɑɡi ɡo u bɔtirɑ Yinni Gusunɔn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ Giliɡɑliɔ.
Yen biru Sɑmuɛli u dɑ Rɑmɑɔ, Sɔɔlu mɑɑ dɑ win yɛnuɔ Gibeɑɔ.
Sere Sɑmuɛli u kɑ ɡu, u ǹ mɑɑ Sɔɔlu mɛɛrim dɑɑre. Adɑmɑ u rɑ n nùn swĩiyɑmmɛwɑ yèn sɔ̃ Gusunɔn nuki sɑnkirɑ ye u kɑ nùn kuɑ Isirelibɑn sunɔ.
Gusunɔ u Dɑfidi ɡɔsɑ
u kɑ ko sunɔ
